Package model.activity

Class EnrichmentActivity

java.lang.Object
model.activity.Activity
model.activity.EnrichmentActivity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Identifiable
public class EnrichmentActivity extends Activity
Represents an enrichment activity for a specific habitat. This class extends the `Activity` class and includes additional attributes specific to enrichment activities, such as the description, duration, and products used.

    • EnrichmentActivity

      public EnrichmentActivity(Habitat habitat, Employee responsible, LocalDate schedulingDate, String description, int durationInDays, ArrayList<String> usedProducts)
      Constructs an EnrichmentActivity object with the specified attributes.
      Parameters:
      habitat - The habitat associated with the activity. Must not be null.
      responsible - The employee responsible for the activity. Must not be null.
      schedulingDate - The date the activity is scheduled for. Must not be null.
      description - The description of the enrichment activity. Must not be null or empty.
      durationInDays - The duration of the activity in days. Must be greater than 0.
      usedProducts - A list of products used for the activity. Must not be null.
